review.why: Maintainer skill for checking published skills against third-party scanners and fixing findings by root cause.
review.summary: Explains how to read the three security audits shown for each published skill, how to reach detailed findings, and common finding types with remediation: credential handling, untrusted external content, unverifiable installs and data exposure. Findings are grouped by root cause, fixed once, then validated. It includes a reusable untrusted-content section.
strengths: Remediate by root cause, not skill by skill
Reusable text block for handling external content safely
Clear remediation for each common finding type
cautions: Internal to one publisher's workflow: little use to other readers
Depends on a third-party scoring site's page layout
